name: 부엉이 우편탑
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: No people, no text, no UI, cinematic view of a round stone owl-post tower, tall arched window at the back, rows of wooden perches holding sleepy owls, bundles of tied letters stacked on the open central floor, brass mail hooks along the curved wall, warm amber lantern glow blending with cool teal moonlight through the window, soft feather textures, low camera angle looking upward past the perches, open lower-central foreground, gentle atmospheric haze, polished storybook concept art.
